messages:
nina_cs: Heads up team 1: Kairo Systems renewal hits in 21 days. They've pushed back on the +12% list increase and asked if we can either (a) do a 9-month "current price" bridge, or (b) accept a PO at current price if it's submitted before month-end. They also asked about VAT handling for their EU subsidiary.
chris_ae: Appreciate the flag. Can we do 9mo at existing price as a one-off concession? If finance ok I can offer that and try to close this week.
rachel_billing: For EU VAT we need the customer's EU VAT ID and billing entity preference (Redwood US vs Redwood EU affiliate). If they bill through their EU subsidiary we'll invoice Redwood EU entity and apply reverse charge where applicable. PO format example sent in DM.
omar_legal: Any requested SOW changes? If they want the 9mo term written into the SOW we need to lock the term language. Also note: if they're asking for data residency or KMS controls that's a separate review.
nina_cs: They want no new controls, just the term and fixed price guarantee for the 9mo. No KMS. They will provide EU VAT ID if needed but prefer a single consolidated invoice.
rev-ops: Finance can approve a short-term 9mo concession at current price as a one-time amendment provided AE confirms exec-level commitment and we capture a PO or signed amendment within 30 days. If PO comes later, we reserve right to retroactively invoice per contract.
chris_ae: I'll push for PO today. If legal needs the amendment text, @omar_legal can you draft a 2-paragraph amendment (term + price protection) we can send for signature?
omar_legal: Yes. I can draft an amendment this afternoon. Expect ~24h turnaround. Include clause: "No price increases during the 9-month term; standard termination and renewal rights unaffected." Any objections?
rachel_billing: Sounds fine. Please ensure the amendment includes billing entity and VAT fields to avoid rework. Also request vendor code early so AP can map the PO.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env_84921. Status: draft. Link: https://docusign.com/envelope/env_84921
nina_cs: Quick risk note: Kairo's procurement team tends to delay vendor-code creation by 10-14 days. If that happens we should allow CC fallback for initial invoice month. @rev-ops is CC fallback approved?
rev-ops: We can allow CC fallback for up to 1 invoice cycle while PO is in progress, but we need AE + CS to attach an exec confirmation email and set clear collection milestones. We'll not recognize revenue as committed until PO or signed amendment received.
chris_ae: Got it. I'll get exec email and chase PO. ETA EOD.
nina_cs: Thanks. I'll post the PO template and our amendment draft when ready. Will update here once DocuSign is out for signature. :pray:
